title: Invitation
brokenLink: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again.
unavailableHint: It may have expired, been withdrawn or already answered, or it was sent to a different email address. Make sure you’re signed in with the verified account the invitation was sent to.
reopenLink: Open the link from the email again
reopenLinkHint: For your security the invitation link isn’t kept while you sign in. Now that you’re signed in, open the same email link again to continue.
expiryNote: Invitations are valid for 7 days after they’re sent. Nothing changes until you answer.
answerFailed: Couldn’t answer this invitation. It may have changed; try again.

offer.project: You’re invited to join a project
offer.team: You’re invited to join a team
offer.company: You’re invited to join a company

conversation.direct: You’re invited to a direct conversation
conversation.group: You’re invited to a group conversation

byEmail.title: Invite by email
byEmail.hint: Type the exact address. The answer is the same whether or not an account exists; the person signs in or signs up with that verified address to respond. Invitations expire after 7 days.
byEmail.failed: Couldn’t create the invitation. Try again.
